description: Gets the geographic heat map of incoming requests for an owner, optionally restricted to a single application. Each point aggregates the number of requests originating from a geographic cell over the time range. Cells are roughly 39 km wide, and the coordinates of a point are the centre of its cell. Requests whose source IP address could not be geolocated are not counted.

applicationId.description: Restrict the heat map to a single application. When omitted, the heat map covers every application of the owner.

from.description: Start of the time range. Defaults to 24 hours before the end of the range.

to.description: End of the time range. Defaults to the start of the current hour.

description: Gets the resource usage time series of an application or an add-on over a time window.

metrics.description: Metrics to return. All of them are returned when omitted or empty.

interval.description: Length of the window to read, as an ISO 8601 duration (`PT30M`, `PT6H`, ...) or a number of milliseconds. Defaults to 30 minutes.

span.description: Size of the sampling buckets the window is cut into, as an ISO 8601 duration or a number of milliseconds. Defaults to 2 minutes. The backend rejects a span more than 300 times smaller than the interval.

end.description: Moment the window ends at. Defaults to now.

fill.description: Whether buckets with no measurement come back with a value of 0 rather than being left out.

timestampUnit.description: Unit of the `timestamp` field in the result.
